system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Close range and choose one:
1- You pull the target into Melee range
or pull yourself into Melee range of it.
2- You constrict the target and force
them to mark 2 Stress.
3- All adversaries between you and the
target must succeed on a Reaction Roll
(13) or be caught by cables taking
3d6+2 physical damage.
On a success, the snare reaches out
from your hands, gear, vehicle, or
drone, causing the chosen effect and
temporarily Restraining the target.
